changes.change: Implemented core Event Lifecycle Management (CRUD) for authorized organizers to handle listings and metadata.
Established standard session-based user authentication and secure login pathways.
Created standard automated participant tracking and digital registrant rosters.
Developed a qualitative attendee feedback collection system with rating metrics.
Integrated flat-file XML migration modules for basic data export and cross-platform backup sharing.
Engineered a dynamic, client-side UI theme engine supporting Light and Dark modes via CSS variables.
Integrated a dynamic XML-driven System Update Log on the login gateway to communicate real-time patch notes to system managers.
Configured database relational structure using a persistent MySQL engine backend.
Normalized database schema to split atomic name structures (first_name, middle_name, last_name)
Shifted schema strategy to direct execution via database engine to preserve legacy environment compatibility
Scaffolded Modular MVC architecture separating Home, Auth, Events, and Registrants domains
Implemented single-entry routing framework (index.php) handling dynamic multi-module request maps
Created event-specific direct registration pipeline linked cleanly via dynamic event_id tracking
Engineered unique alphanumeric transactional token engine (ABCD-1234 pattern) mapping to reference_id tracking keys
Built cross-module validation engine inside EventFeedback model protecting submission writes against unverified reference tokens
